plugins.name: agent-doe-engine
plugins.description: A design-of-experiments engine for tuning AI agents. It finds which settings actually change your results, tells you whether each change is real or just run-to-run noise, and picks the best combination when speed, cost, and quality compete. One planned batch of trials instead of guessing or testing one thing at a time.
